# The Stallion Metallist

> International metal-scrap trading company. Canada-incorporated (Calgary, AB) and
> operating on the ground in Dehradun, India. We source ferrous and non-ferrous
> scrap across UAE, China, Europe and North America and deliver to India's furnaces,
> foundries and mills. We also run a UBC (used aluminium can) doorstep-collection app.

## What we trade
- Ferrous: Heavy Melting Scrap (HMS 1&2, Fe ≥ 92%), Shredded Scrap, Cast Iron (foundry), Structural & Industrial
- Non-ferrous: Aluminium (UBC · Zorba), Copper (Millberry), Brass (Honey), Stainless Steel (304/316)

## How we operate
Source → Negotiate → Clear (Mundra, Kandla, JNPT) → Deliver (Gujarat belt) → Settle (LC at sight / T/T)

## Scale
~50,000+ tonnes/year · 4 sourcing markets · 3 major Indian ports · 100+ vetted partners
